newsitem.title: USA: Rexene in merger talks with Huntsman.
newsitem.headline: Rexene in merger talks with Huntsman.

text.p: Petrochemical company Rexene Corp. said on Monday that it was in discussions with Huntsman Corp. regarding the Huntsman's acquisition of Rexene for $16 per share.

Rexene said that there can be no guarantee that a definitive agreement with Huntsman would be reached or that a sale of the company would be consummated. The total value of the bid could not be immediately determined.
Rexene also said that as a result of these developments, it will adjourn until June 12 the special meeting of stockholders that was scheduled to be held on May 22.

Rexene's board had rejected a $16 a share bid from Huntsman on Nov. 4, according to Rexene's earlier Securities and Exchange filing. Rexene had also rejected a $15 a share bid from Huntsman in August.

Dissident shareholders Wyser-Pratte & Co. Inc. and Spear Leeds & Kellogg are backing a change in Rexene's by-laws to make it easier to sell the company and also replace Rexene's board. The dissident shareholders own about 13 percent of Rexene.
